comment: Small vero board for a PIC-controlled relay bypass, shown populated, as a colour wiring diagram, bare underside and etched PCB; no legend. The regulator is marked only O G I on the vero view and 78L05 on the wiring diagram. Sw1/Sw2 go to the bypass footswitch (not listed).
